    modified = sum(1 for x in porcelain if x.startswith('M ') or x.startswith(' M') or x.startswith('AM') or x.startswith('RM'))

    creation_date = run_git("git log --reverse --format='%ar' | head -n 1")
    last_change = run_git("git log -1 --format='%ar'")

    authors_raw = run_git("git shortlog -sn --all").split('\\n')
    authors = []
    total_commits = 0
    for a in authors_raw:
        if not a.strip(): continue
        parts = a.strip().split('\\t', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            c = int(parts[0])
            total_commits += c
            authors.append({"name": parts[1], "email": None, "nbrOfCommits": c, "contribution": 0})
    
    for a in authors:
        a["contribution"] = int(round(a["nbrOfCommits"] / total_commits * 100)) if total_commits else 0
        
    num_commits = run_git("git rev-list --count HEAD")
    num_commits = int(num_commits) if num_commits else 0
    
    churn_files = run_git("git log --name-only --format='' | grep -v '^$' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -n 3").split('\\n')
    file_churns = []
    for c in churn_files:
        if not c.strip(): continue
        parts = c.strip().split(None, 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            file_churns.append({"filePath": parts[1], "nbrOfCommits": int(parts[0])})
            
    tracked = run_git("git ls-files").split('\\n')
    untracked = run_git("git ls-files --others --exclude-standard").split('\\n')
    all_files = [f for f in tracked + untracked if f.strip() and os.path.isfile(f)]
    
    ext_map = {

        ".cpp": "Cpp", ".hpp": "Cpp", ".cc": "Cpp", ".cxx": "Cpp",
        ".js": "JavaScript", ".jsx": "JavaScript",

        ".java": "Java", ".go": "Go", ".sh": "Sh", ".bash": "Sh",
        ".rb": "Ruby", ".php": "Php", ".html": "Html", ".css": "Css",
        ".cs": "C#", ".swift": "Swift", ".kt": "Kotlin", ".kts": "Kotlin",
        ".scala": "Scala", ".dart": "Dart", ".lua": "Lua", ".md": "Markdown"
    }

    langs_loc = {}
    total_loc = 0

    for f in all_files:
        ext = os.path.splitext(f)[1].lower()
        if f.endswith("compile.sh"): ext = ".sh"
        if ext in ext_map:
            lang = ext_map[ext]
            loc = 0
            try:
                with open(f, 'r', errors='ignore') as file:
                    for line in file:
                        s = line.strip()
                        if not s: continue
                        if s.startswith('#') or s.startswith('//') or s.startswith('/*') or s.startswith('*') or s.startswith('<!--'): continue
                        loc += 1
            except: pass
            if loc > 0:
                langs_loc[lang] = langs_loc.get(lang, 0) + loc
                total_loc += loc
                
    languages = []
    for lang, loc in sorted(langs_loc.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):

    size = sum(os.path.getsize(f) for f in tracked if f.strip() and os.path.exists(f))

    info_fields.append({"VersionInfo": {"version": ""}})
    
    if creation_date:
        info_fields.append({"CreatedInfo": {"creationDate": creation_date}})
        
    if languages:
        info_fields.append({"LanguagesInfo": {"languagesWithPercentage": languages}})
        
    info_fields.append({"DependenciesInfo": {"dependencies": ""}})
    
    if authors:
        info_fields.append({"AuthorsInfo": {"authors": authors}})
        
    if last_change:
        info_fields.append({"LastChangeInfo": {"lastChange": last_change}})
        
    if len(authors) > 0:
        info_fields.append({"ContributorsInfo": {"totalNumberOfAuthors": len(authors)}})
        
    info_fields.append({"UrlInfo": {"repoUrl": ""}})
    
    if num_commits > 0:
        info_fields.append({"CommitsInfo": {"numberOfCommits": num_commits, "isShallow": False}})
        info_fields.append({"ChurnInfo": {"file_churns": file_churns, "churn_pool_size": num_commits}})
        
    if total_loc > 0:
        info_fields.append({"LocInfo": {"linesOfCode": total_loc}})
        
    if len([x for x in tracked if x.strip()]) > 0:
        info_fields.append({"SizeInfo": {"repoSize": repo_size, "fileCount": len([x for x in tracked if x.strip()])}})
        
    info_fields.append({"LicenseInfo": {"license": "MIT"}})
        
    return {
        "title": {
            "gitUsername": username,
            "gitVersion": git_version
        },
        "infoFields": info_fields
    }

def print_text_format(info):
    lines = []
    t = info['title']
    lines.append(f"{t['gitUsername']} ~ {t['gitVersion']}")
    lines.append("-----------------------------------")
    
    for f in info['infoFields']:
        if "HeadInfo" in f:
            lines.append(f"HEAD: {f['HeadInfo']['headRefs']['shortCommitId']} ({f['HeadInfo']['headRefs']['refs'][0] if f['HeadInfo']['headRefs']['refs'] else ''})")
        elif "PendingInfo" in f:
            p = f["PendingInfo"]
            parts = []
            if p["modified"]: parts.append(f"{p['modified']}+-")
            if p["added"]: parts.append(f"{p['added']}+")
            if p["deleted"]: parts.append(f"{p['deleted']}-")
            if parts:
                lines.append(f"Pending: {' '.join(parts)}")
        elif "CreatedInfo" in f:
            lines.append(f"Created: {f['CreatedInfo']['creationDate']}")
        elif "LanguagesInfo" in f:
            langs = f["LanguagesInfo"]["languagesWithPercentage"]
            l_str = " ".join([f"{x['language']} ({x['percentage']:.1f} %)" for x in langs])
            lines.append(f"Languages: {l_str}")
        elif "AuthorsInfo" in f:
            for a in f["AuthorsInfo"]["authors"]:
                lines.append(f"Author: {a['contribution']}% {a['name']} {a['nbrOfCommits']}")
        elif "LastChangeInfo" in f:
            lines.append(f"Last change: {f['LastChangeInfo']['lastChange']}")
        elif "CommitsInfo" in f:
            lines.append(f"Commits: {f['CommitsInfo']['numberOfCommits']}")
        elif "ChurnInfo" in f:
            ch = f["ChurnInfo"]
            if ch["file_churns"]:
                lines.append(f"Churn ({ch['churn_pool_size']}): {ch['file_churns'][0]['filePath']} {ch['file_churns'][0]['nbrOfCommits']}")
                for c in ch['file_churns'][1:]:
                    lines.append(f"           {c['filePath']} {c['nbrOfCommits']}")
        elif "LocInfo" in f:
            lines.append(f"Lines of code: {f['LocInfo']['linesOfCode']}")
        elif "SizeInfo" in f:
            lines.append(f"Size: {f['SizeInfo']['repoSize']} ({f['SizeInfo']['fileCount']} files)")
        elif "LicenseInfo" in f:
            lines.append(f"License: {f['LicenseInfo']['license']}")
            
    print("\\n".join(lines))

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Command-line Git information tool", add_help=False)
    parser.add_argument('-h', '--help', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('-V', '--version', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('-o', '--output')
    parser.add_argument('-l', '--languages', action='store_true')
